senses.gloss: , pl. תּוֹתֵי prep. (contr. of תְּחוֹת) under, beneath; in the place of.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 25:1">Targ. Y. I Num. XXV, 1</cite>.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ bot. <he>ההיא שטפה … תּוֹתֵיה</he> the river has swept away this (thy) piece of meat and brought another piece in its stead.—[<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>אתר תותיה</he>, <he>אתר תתה</he>, read: <he>אַתַּרְתֵּיה</he>, <he>אַתַּרְתָּהּ</he> (fr. <cite ref="N01392"><he>נתר</he></cite>) it dropped it]—
<cite ref="Chullin 7b">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>מתותי כרעי וכ׳</he> (not <he>מתותי׳</he>) from under the feet of &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:8">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>נגדי … מִתּוֹתַיְהוּ</he> rivers of fat flew under them.
<cite ref="Zevachim 54b:2">Zeb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>מחית מידי מתותיה וכ׳</he> he placed something under it (the altar), and then took it away; a. fr.
